display.purpose: The delegated outcome in the hero only.

headline.purpose: Execution, attention, evidence, and state headings.

label.purpose: Real fields and channels, never decorative kickers.

evidence.purpose: Identifiers, timestamps, counters, and exact values.

shadows.name: modal-focus
shadows.purpose: Creates protected focus around a native modal dialog.

shadows.name: particle-emission
shadows.purpose: Supplies emitted depth inside the portrait only.

motion.name: portrait-assembly
motion.purpose: Introduces the living authority field once; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: evidence-arrival
motion.purpose: Carries one particle from the assembled portrait to each completed evidence step.

motion.name: state-damping
motion.purpose: Transitions portrait color, dispersion, jitter, and pulse without abrupt visual jumps.

components.name: Control Button
components.description: A compact neutral action for audits and modal decisions.
components.css: .ds-control-button { height: 33px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #f2f5f7; font: 400 14px/1 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background .4s, border-color .4s; } .ds-control-button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); } .ds-control-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6fefff; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-control-button:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: The current location in the matte mission rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { display: flex; width: 168px; height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); color: #f2f5f7; text-decoration: none; font: 400 16px/1 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-selected i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6fefff; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #54dfff; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6fefff; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Demo Approval Chip
components.description: An explicitly illustrative Alexa+ authority source.
components.css: .ds-approval { display: inline-flex; height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(100,154,255,.25); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(50,95,150,.05); color: #aecbff; font: 400 10px/1 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-approval i { width: 13px; height: 13px; border: 1px solid #6ca7e9; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Instrument Panel
components.description: A broad tonal region for execution, attention, or evidence.
components.html:
Plan adapts. Authority does not.

Execution remains inside the approved envelope.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 420px; padding: 17px 23px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(130deg, rgba(11,17,21,.66), rgba(8,13,19,.66)); color: #f2f5f7; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 9px 0 0; color: #8a949e; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Authority Meter
components.description: A thin measured line ending at an immutable boundary mark.
components.css: .ds-authority { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 170px minmax(0,1fr) 70px; align-items: center; gap: 22px; color: #f2f5f7; font: 400 11px/1 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-authority > span { position: relative; height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-authority i { display: block; width: 62%; height: 1px; background: #6fefff; box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(111,239,255,.3); } .ds-authority b { position: absolute; right: 0; top: -5px; width: 1px; height: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.33); } .ds-authority em { color: #8a949e; font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; text-align: right; }

components.name: Boundary Action
components.description: A fail-closed amendment review action with a restrained blocked-state border.
components.css: .ds-boundary-action { padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,91,87,.19); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #f2f5f7; font: 400 11px/1 Inter, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background .4s, border-color .4s; } .ds-boundary-action:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.045); border-color: rgba(255,91,87,.32); } .ds-boundary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6fefff; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
Mandate is a dark operational instrument for supervising autonomy under explicit limits. Its focal object is a procedurally assembled agent portrait whose color, coherence, and surrounding field change with authority state. The interface should feel observed and exact rather than theatrical: near-black space, quiet hairlines, compact data labels, and one luminous mechanism doing real work.

The visual world is optimized for a principal checking a consequential run under dim, focused working conditions. It is futuristic because the product mechanism is visible, not because generic neon chrome has been applied to ordinary cards.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black mission-control field with sparse, hairline structure
One dominant procedural particle portrait paired with the authority envelope
Cyan for in-scope execution, amber for review, and red only for a blocked expansion
Compact operational labels, plain-language decisions, and locally rendered evidence
A single assembly-to-evidence motion sequence rather than scattered entrance effects

rules.name: The State-Light Rule
rules.body: Color belongs to execution state. Neutral content does not borrow cyan, amber, red, or green for decoration.

rules.name: The Fail-Closed Red Rule
rules.body: Red means an attempted authority expansion was stopped before execution; routine review uses amber, and status always includes language.

rules.name: The Operational-Label Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase type names a real field or channel. Do not add an eyebrow merely to decorate a heading.

rules.name: The Mechanism-First Rule
rules.body: The mandate and living authority field share the first viewport; generic metrics never lead the page.

rules.name: The Contained-Light Rule
rules.body: Emitted light stays inside the portrait, a status point, or the active authority line. Broad surfaces remain matte.

dos: Do make the authority boundary and current execution state readable without interpreting the portrait color.
Do preserve the portrait's ±4° interaction limit and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep every live-service claim explicitly offline or illustrative until authenticated evidence exists.
Do use local assets with attribution and embedded provenance.
Do let one state transition carry the motion story, then keep the console quiet.
donts: Don't use state colors for generic links, borders, or decorative emphasis.
Don't turn supporting information into an equal-weight metric grid.
Don't replace the procedural portrait with a static generic AI avatar or remote runtime asset.
Don't use red for review, warning, or urgency when no authority expansion was actually blocked.
Don't add promotional eyebrows; compact uppercase labels must identify a real operational field.
Don't present fixture timestamps, approvals, evidence, or AgentOS/Alexa+ status as live.
